newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-DE GLANVILLE NAMED AS NEW ENGLAND CAPTAIN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-DE GLANVILLE NAMED AS NEW ENGLAND CAPTAIN.

text.p: Phil de Glanville was unveiled as England's new rugby union captain on Tuesday, casting doubt over the future international prospects of former skipper Will Carling.
The Bath captain occupies the same centre position as Carling and his selection by coach Jack Rowell signals the end of the long-established partnership between his predecessor and Jeremy Guscott.
De Glanville, 28, has won 16 caps and occupied the replacements' bench 21 times. He won his first cap as a replacement in 1992 at Twickenham against South Africa.

He has beaten off the leadership challenges of Harlequins' Jason Leonard and Wasps' Lawrence Dallaglio to become the first formally appointed England captain since Carling's promotion eight years ago.
